sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
Color Reflections is a large-format digital printing company founded in the mid-1980s that provides custom printing solutions including banners, vehicle wraps, trade show displays, and signage.

Industry: Printing · HQ: Houston, Texas · Size: <$50M · Products: Custom banners, Vehicle wraps, Wall wraps, Trade show displays, Window graphics, POP displays

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: Color Reflections scores 78 of 100 (tier A) at 90% confidence. The score is carried by industry fit (30/30), application fit (25/25) and event engagement (14/15).

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: They already market on lifespan, which means the durability conversation is a product discussion rather than an education. Relevant Tedlar positioning: Tedlar overlaminates let printers underwrite longer graphic warranties.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Mactac (29% similar on printing, vinyl, digital, signage); Drytac (18% similar on print, graphics, printing, wall); Avery Dennison Graphics Solutions (18% similar on graphics, vinyl, color, vehicle). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.
